problem.title: Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Length K
problem.problemStatement: Given a string and an integer K, determine the maximum number of vowels present in any substring of length exactly K.
problem.input: • First line contains string S. • Second line contains integer K.
problem.output: • Print the maximum number of vowels.
